nonblocking_findings: Commit 3b22a6af changes tests/storytime-u2-guards.test.ts, which is outside the Owned paths of the spec. Verdict: safe test hardening, not a scope fault. The tests U2G10 and U2G11 now run the muse CLI in a temp repository (scripts copied, node_modules symlinked) instead of the real repository. The old form ran the CLI with the real repository as cwd and then deleted the real unit 2 and family-word folders when the run had created them. The step F defect (the test CVG9 wrote into the real cover cost file and deleted it) proved this pattern was a live hazard to the cost files the guard reads. The change keeps every assertion and test name, changes no production code, and removes the hazard. A separate commit under an explicit test-hardening note would have been cleaner, but the change is small, reviewable, and preserves all test intent.

The exact combined-hash form of maker-p2g.log could not be reproduced: 42 variants (sorted bare hashes, sha256sum-style lines with relative, absolute, dot, name, and repo-relative paths, JSON and Python repr forms, several joiners and line endings) gave no match, for either v1 folder. The maker script /tmp/opencode/l2rc/v1-hash.sh lived in scratch and Task 8 deleted it per D13, so the exact form is unrecoverable. Check 6 (v1 folders unchanged) passes on three independent corroborations: the file counts match the recorded counts exactly (441 and 469); the newest file mtime in both v1 folders is 2026-11-08 (delivery-muse-v1 20:25:09Z, hand-off 20:27:26Z), two days before this track started, so nothing wrote there during the track; and maker-p2g.log records the same combined hashes before and after its Task 5 work. The recorded combined hashes stand as maker evidence.
